settings.heading: Your engagement ring, designed with a jeweller and priced without the middleman
settings.text: Choose a certified diamond and a setting online, or sit down with us on Langtree Avenue. Either way you see the price of the stone and the setting before you commit.

settings.image_alt: Custom-designed engagement ring being tried on
settings.heading: Remodel an heirloom or design a ring from scratch
settings.text:
Bring in a ring you have inherited, a stone you own or a photo you like. We talk through stones, metals and settings in plain English, and you see the price before any work starts.

Prefer to do it online? The ring builder pairs our settings with certified diamonds from our suppliers, with no third party adding margin.

settings.title: The diamond
settings.text: Certified lab-grown or natural stones from our suppliers, each with its grading report. Pick shape, carat, colour and clarity and watch the price change.

settings.title: The setting
settings.text: Six settings, each in the shapes it suits, made to order for your stone.

settings.title: The band
settings.text: Yellow, white or rose gold in 9ct, 14ct or 18ct, or platinum.

settings.heading: One ring. Three decisions.
settings.text: Every ring in the builder comes down to three choices. Make them online, or with us in store.

settings.title: Choose your metal
settings.text: yellow, white or rose gold, or platinum

settings.title: Set profile and width
settings.text: flat, half-round or comfort fit, sized in store

settings.title: Finish and engrave
settings.text: polished, brushed or hammered, engraving available

settings.heading: Match a wedding band to your ring, or start from scratch
settings.text: Pick the metal, profile, width and finish in the wedding ring builder. Order online, or book a fitting and we will check the size in store.
